source: Joico LumiShine Repair+ Permanent Crème Color technical data sheet

numbering_system.description: Joico LumiShine uses level number followed by tone letter code(s). NN = Double Natural, N = Natural, NA = Natural Ash, AA = Double Ash, NWB = Natural Warm Beige, NW = Natural Warm, NG = Natural Gold, NNG = Double Natural Gold, NNA = Double Natural Ash.
numbering_system.high_lift_xl: XL shades available in level 11-12 range for maximum lift
numbering_system.intensifiers: INCG and INRR can be added to any formula for custom tonal direction

lines.name: LumiShine Repair+ Permanent Crème Color
lines.processingTime: 35 minutes standard; 45 minutes for grey coverage and High Lift XL
lines.description: Low ammonia permanent crème color with ArgiPlex technology, Quadramine Complex, and Gentle Fresh Fragrance. 100% grey coverage.
lines.youthLock_note: YouthLock shares the exact same shade codes as Permanent Crème Color

10_vol.use: Deposit only, tone-on-tone, grey coverage, darker coloring

20_vol.use: 1-2 levels of lift, grey coverage, standard permanent color service

40_vol.use: 3-4 levels of lift, High Lift XL shades only

gray_coverage.rule: 100% grey coverage on all LumiShine Permanent shades
gray_coverage.nn_series: Double Neutral (NN) shades provide extra coverage for resistant grey hair
gray_coverage.resistant_hair: Use 30 volume developer for resistant grey hair; 40 volume for High Lift XL
gray_coverage.processing_time: 35 minutes standard; extend to 45 minutes for maximum grey coverage

lift_guidelines.40_vol: 3-4 levels of lift (High Lift XL only)

grey_coverage.standard: 100% on all shades with appropriate developer
grey_coverage.resistant: Use NN series or increase developer volume to 30
grey_coverage.processing: 35 min standard; extend to 45 min for resistant grey

processing_times.grey_coverage: 35 minutes; extend to 45 minutes for resistant grey

intensifier_usage.INCG: Add up to 1/4 tube to formula for copper-gold enhancement
intensifier_usage.INRR: Add up to 1/4 tube to formula for red enhancement
intensifier_usage.mixing: Mix with chosen LumiShine shade and developer as normal
